item.whispersofrlyeh.necronomicon.toolti: That is not dead which can eternal lie...
item.whispersofrlyeh.elder_sign.tooltip: While carried, it shields your mind from what lurks.
message.whispersofrlyeh.necronomicon.spe: The strength of the Old Ones flows through you.
message.whispersofrlyeh.necronomicon.bac: The pages whisper back. Your mind bleeds.
message.whispersofrlyeh.elder_sign.repel: The Elder Sign blazes with ancient light!
message.whispersofrlyeh.whisper.0: Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn...
message.whispersofrlyeh.whisper.3: He dreams. And in his dream, you are there.
message.whispersofrlyeh.whisper.5: Do not look at the water.
